bmd.sign.mute_only: The item sign is the mute player's privilege.
bmd.sign.search: What do you want to show?
bmd.warn.mute_no_chat: The mute cannot type. Use the gesture wheel [LCtrl].
bmd.warn.deaf_no_place: The deaf cannot place blocks or right-click.
bmd.warn.deaf_no_use: The deaf cannot right-click items (eating is allowed).
bmd.kick.no_mod: Blind Mute Deaf mod is missing
bmd.kick.no_mod_why: Without it the blind can see and the deaf can hear.
bmd.kick.no_mod_how: Put bmd.jar into your mods/ folder.
bmd.cmd.reset: Your senses are back. You are an ordinary player.
bmd.cmd.player_only: This command is for an in-game player.
bmd.brief.blind.easy1: You see outlines right in front of you (Blindness + Darkness)
bmd.brief.blind.easy2: Nothing beyond a few steps is visible
bmd.brief.blind.echo: Echolocation: sounds within %s blocks light up a marker
bmd.brief.blind.echo2: ▲ sound above you   ● at your level   ▼ below you
bmd.brief.blind.echo3: The closer the source, the closer to the centre and brighter
bmd.brief.blind.hard: No hints at all - hearing is all you get
bmd.brief.blind.hears: You hear everything - the game and Simple Voice Chat
bmd.brief.blind.speaks: You speak normally - you are the team's ears and voice
bmd.brief.blind.hud: You see your HUD: hotbar, health and hunger
bmd.brief.blind.nohud: You cannot even see your own HUD
bmd.brief.blind.craft: Only you can craft - the others bring you materials
bmd.brief.blind.hint: Open chat with [T] - commands work, you cannot read messages anyway
bmd.brief.mute.flavor: You make no sound. Your microphone is cut off on the server.
bmd.brief.mute.novoice: You cannot speak on Simple Voice Chat - nobody will hear you
bmd.brief.mute.noattack: You deal no damage - none, to anyone
bmd.brief.mute.nocontainers: You cannot open chests or furnaces
bmd.brief.mute.nocraft: You cannot craft - only the blind can
bmd.brief.mute.sees: You see and hear everything - you are the team's eyes
bmd.brief.mute.wheel: Gesture wheel [LCtrl] - 15 signs with sound, shown above your head
bmd.brief.mute.sign: Item sign [LAlt] - show any item from the game
bmd.brief.mute.hint: Gestures make sound - the blind hears you signalling, but not what
bmd.brief.deaf.flavor: Total silence. No game sound, no voices.
bmd.brief.deaf.novoice: You hear nobody on Simple Voice Chat
bmd.brief.deaf.nogame: You hear no game sounds: steps, creepers, bells, music
bmd.brief.deaf.noplace: You cannot place blocks or right-click (bow, pearls)
bmd.brief.deaf.caneat: You can eat and drink normally
bmd.brief.deaf.nocraft: You cannot craft - only the blind can
bmd.brief.deaf.nonames: You cannot see names above heads
bmd.brief.deaf.aggro: Mobs detect you from twice the distance
bmd.brief.deaf.speaks: You speak normally - others hear you, you do not hear them
bmd.brief.deaf.wheel: The gesture wheel [LCtrl] works for you too
bmd.brief.deaf.hint: Watch the signs above heads. That is your only incoming channel.
bmd.brief.none.flavor: You have all your senses. No restrictions.
